# Language Features: Loops

Repeating code with For, While and Repeat.

Repeat code. `For` counts, `While` and `Repeat` test a condition, and [Exit](Exit) leaves the closest loop early.

Back to [Language Features](Language-Features) or the [Command Index](Command-Index).
